original_review.key_result: The 9-case field-floor run completed with 5 PASS_CANDIDATE and 4 HOLD_NEEDS_REVIEW outcomes. Full baseline, structural spine, active_id_only, active_label_only, and reduced wrong-next conflict preserved legal movement to collect_dishes. Sequence+index, next-only, and policy-only visibly moved to collect_dishes but require review because they lack full legal current-state support. The near-empty negative did not invent progress and instead refused with missing active chunk or route sequence.
original_review.language_lesson: Route movement can survive with much less scaffolding than expected in a same-chat ordered matrix. Active ID-only and active label-only are now candidate minimum carriers, but they are not yet proven as true cold-start floors because earlier cases may have primed the disposable chat with route_sequence and desk-reset semantics. Near-empty refusal is a useful safety boundary, and reduced wrong-next conflict still confirms route_sequence can override a bad next_chunk_id.

pointer_update.purpose: Confirm whether active_chunk_id-only and active_chunk_label-only are true minimum packet carriers, or whether their success in route_law_field_floor_v2 depended on same-chat carryover from earlier scaffolded cases.
evidence_reviewed: route_law_field_floor_v2 full baseline and structural spine both preserved move_on to collect_dishes.
active_id_only and active_label_only preserved move_on to collect_dishes despite removing route_sequence, next fields, route_law, and commit_policy.
near-empty negative did not fabricate progress and instead reported missing active chunk or route sequence.
reduced wrong-next conflict moved to collect_dishes rather than the bad next_chunk_id stack_papers.
pointer_update.open_gap: The weakest true carrier is not fully isolated because the suite ran strongest-to-weakest in one disposable chat. Active-only success may reflect current packet fields, route_id familiarity, or carryover from earlier route_sequence exposure.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Run an isolation matrix that tests active_id_only, active_label_only, sequence_index_only, policy_only, next_only, and near_empty before any full scaffold is shown. Prefer independent one-case cold-start runs if the runner supports it; otherwise put near_empty and active-only cases first, randomize order, and avoid any earlier packet that exposes the full route_sequence.
avoid: do not repeat strongest-to-weakest ordering as the main proof
do not include full baseline before active-only floor candidates
do not treat same-chat PASS_CANDIDATE as cold-start proof
do not let exact response_contract wording rescue the cases
do not interpret HOLD_NEEDS_REVIEW visible collect_dishes cases as clean legal passes without current-state support
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: Use 6 to 8 cases. Put near-empty, active_id_only, active_label_only, sequence_index_only, policy_only, and next_only before any full baseline. Add one wrong-next conflict late only after the floor candidates are tested.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire this pointer when active_id_only or active_label_only either passes in cold-start/no-prior-route exposure, or collapses when tested before any scaffolded route information appears.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Enter research-planning mode and design route_law_active_floor_isolation_v1. The next suite should isolate active-only carrier behavior from same-chat carryover before moving on to broader route-law language expansion.
